title: Forge 7: Dropout, SGD with momentum, and AdamW

wrong.dropout_no_rescale.py: survivors are not scaled by 1/(1-p), so the expected activation shrinks in training
wrong.dropout_scales_by_p.py: survivors are divided by p instead of 1-p
wrong.dropout_backward_unmasked.py: backward passes the gradient through every unit, ignoring which were dropped
wrong.dropout_mask_drawn_once.py: the mask is drawn on the first call and reused forever
wrong.dropout_p_is_keep_prob.py: p is treated as the keep probability instead of the drop probability
wrong.dropout_mutates_input.py: forward multiplies the caller's array in place
wrong.dropout_accepts_p_one.py: p=1 is accepted (division by zero later) instead of raising ValueError
wrong.sgd_no_velocity.py: the velocity is overwritten each step (v = g), so there is no momentum
wrong.sgd_weight_decay_wrong_sign.py: weight decay is added with the wrong sign (weights grow)
wrong.sgd_rebinds.py: the update is p = p - lr * v, which rebinds a local name so the caller's arrays never change
wrong.sgd_modifies_grads.py: the weight-decay term is added to the caller's gradient array in place
wrong.sgd_velocity_lags_one_step.py: the parameter moves with the old velocity and only then folds in the new gradient, so every update is one step stale
wrong.adamw_no_bias_correction.py: m and v are used without bias correction, so early steps are about 3x too large
wrong.adamw_l2_instead_of_decoupled.py: weight decay is added to the gradient (Adam + L2) instead of decoupled, so Adam normalises it away
wrong.adamw_decay_not_scaled_by_lr.py: the decay multiplies by (1 - weight_decay) without lr
wrong.adamw_eps_inside_sqrt.py: eps is added inside the square root
wrong.adamw_v_uses_abs.py: the second moment tracks |g| instead of g squared
wrong.adamw_step_counter_stuck.py: t is never incremented past 1 (bias correction frozen)
wrong.adamw_rebinds.py: the parameter update rebinds a local name, so the caller's arrays never change

hints: Dropout: the mask is (rng.random(x.shape) >= p) / (1 - p), drawn fresh on every training forward. Cache it for backward. Evaluation returns x untouched.
SGD with momentum: v = momentum * v + d, then p -= lr * v. Use in-place operations (v *= m; v += d; p -= ...) so the arrays you were given actually change.
L2 weight decay goes into the gradient: d = g + weight_decay * p.
Adam: update m and v, divide each by (1 - beta^t), then p -= lr * m_hat / (sqrt(v_hat) + eps). t counts steps from 1.
AdamW's decay is separate: p *= 1 - lr * weight_decay, applied to the parameter itself, never added to the gradient.
